body:
Hey @chreno, nice catch, that's definitely a bug that needs to be fixed. You found the right line of the source code. 

Maybe we should move https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/fastlane/lib/fastlane/fastlane_folder.rb#L6 to fastlane_core, so that it can be used across the tools, what do you think?
Hi @KrauseFx, yeah, moving it to fastlane_core and use it as a single source of truth everywhere seems to be the right way!
Hi @chreno Are you interested in submitting a PR? We'd love to see you contributing to our project! 👍 💯 💯
Hi @TKBurner Sure, I'm happy to contribute! Will try to apply the fix in the upcoming days.
Cool, thanks @chreno. Let us know if you need any help getting started 👍

issue.title: Moved fastlane_folder to fastlane_core, fixed deliver issue

repository.name: fastlane
repository.description: 🚀 The easiest way to automate building and releasing your iOS and Android apps

issue.body:
Moved fastlane_folder.rb from fastlane to fastlane_core. The original trigger for this refactor was issue #5696.

Fixed deliver detect_values find_folders method, applied a minimal refactor and also added a some tests for the method.

Question: Do you think that create_folder and available_lanes should also be moved to fastlane_core, or should we separate the class and keep these in fastlane?
